prompt:
Summarize this external code review in 1-3 concise sentences. Focus on WHAT the reviewer wants changed, not boilerplate. Strip tool share links, HTML tags, promotional text.

## Review Feedback
Hey - I've left some high level feedback:

- The Tempest job’s release matrix in `.github/workflows/ci.yaml` is now a hardcoded list of releases; consider deriving this from the same `generate-matrix` output used in `build-images.yaml` to avoid having to touch multiple places when adding or removing releases.
- In `verify_release_config.sh`, the extra-packages validation now enforces `keystone.pip_extras` and `keystone.apt_packages` to have at least one entry for every `releases/*/extra-packages.yaml`; if a future release legitimately has no extras or apt packages, this will cause false negatives, so you may want to allow empty lists and only assert schema/format.
